records.title: Security management process
records.text: Implement policies and procedures to prevent, detect, contain, and correct security violations.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Risk analysis
records.text: Conduct an accurate and thorough assessment of the potential risks and vulnerabilities to the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of electronic protected health information held by the covered entity or business associate.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Risk management
records.text: Implement security measures sufficient to reduce risks and vulnerabilities to a reasonable and appropriate level to comply with § 164.306(a).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Sanction policy
records.text: Apply appropriate sanctions against workforce members who fail to comply with the security policies and procedures of the covered entity or business associate.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Information system activity review
records.text: Implement procedures to regularly review records of information system activity, such as audit logs, access reports, and security incident tracking reports.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Assigned security responsibility
records.text: Identify the security official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures required by this subpart for the covered entity or business associate.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Workforce security
records.text: Implement policies and procedures to ensure that all members of its workforce have appropriate access to electronic protected health information, as provided under paragraph (a)(4) of this section, and to prevent those workforce members who do not have access under paragraph (a)(4) of this section from obtaining access to electronic protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Authorization and/or supervision
records.text: Implement procedures for the authorization and/or supervision of workforce members who work with electronic protected health information or in locations where it might be accessed.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Workforce clearance procedure
records.text: Implement procedures to determine that the access of a workforce member to electronic protected health information is appropriate.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Termination procedures
records.text: Implement procedures for terminating access to electronic protected health information when the employment of, or other arrangement with, a workforce member ends or as required by determinations made as specified in paragraph (a)(3)(ii)(B) of this section.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Information access management
records.text: Implement policies and procedures for authorizing access to electronic protected health information that are consistent with the applicable requirements of subpart E of this part.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Isolating health care clearinghouse functions
records.text: If a health care clearinghouse is part of a larger organization, the clearinghouse must implement policies and procedures that protect the electronic protected health information of the clearinghouse from unauthorized access by the larger organization.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Access authorization
records.text: Implement policies and procedures for granting access to electronic protected health information, for example, through access to a workstation, transaction, program, process, or other mechanism.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Access establishment and modification
records.text: Implement policies and procedures that, based upon the covered entity's or the business associate's access authorization policies, establish, document, review, and modify a user's right of access to a workstation, transaction, program, or process.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Security awareness and training
records.text: Implement a security awareness and training program for all members of its workforce (including management).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Security reminders
records.text: Periodic security updates.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Protection from malicious software
records.text: Procedures for guarding against, detecting, and reporting malicious software.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Log-in monitoring
records.text: Procedures for monitoring log-in attempts and reporting discrepancies.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Password management
records.text: Procedures for creating, changing, and safeguarding passwords.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Security incident procedures
records.text: Implement policies and procedures to address security incidents.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Response and reporting
records.text: Identify and respond to suspected or known security incidents; mitigate, to the extent practicable, harmful effects of security incidents that are known to the covered entity or business associate; and document security incidents and their outcomes.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Contingency plan
records.text: Establish (and implement as needed) policies and procedures for responding to an emergency or other occurrence (for example, fire, vandalism, system failure, and natural disaster) that damages systems that contain electronic protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Data backup plan
records.text: Establish and implement procedures to create and maintain retrievable exact copies of electronic protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Disaster recovery plan
records.text: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures to restore any loss of data.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Emergency mode operation plan
records.text: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures to enable continuation of critical business processes for protection of the security of electronic protected health information while operating in emergency mode.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Testing and revision procedures
records.text: Implement procedures for periodic testing and revision of contingency plans.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Applications and data criticality analysis
records.text: Assess the relative criticality of specific applications and data in support of other contingency plan components.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Evaluation
records.text: Perform a periodic technical and nontechnical evaluation, based initially upon the standards implemented under this rule and, subsequently, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of electronic protected health information, that establishes the extent to which a covered entity's or business associate's security policies and procedures meet the requirements of this subpart.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Written contract or other arrangement
records.text: Document the satisfactory assurances required by paragraph (b)(1) or (b)(2) of this section through a written contract or other arrangement with the business associate that meets the applicable requirements of § 164.314(a).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Facility access controls
records.text: Implement policies and procedures to limit physical access to its electronic information systems and the facility or facilities in which they are housed, while ensuring that properly authorized access is allowed.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Contingency operations
records.text: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures that allow facility access in support of restoration of lost data under the disaster recovery plan and emergency mode operations plan in the event of an emergency.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Facility security plan
records.text: Implement policies and procedures to safeguard the facility and the equipment therein from unauthorized physical access, tampering, and theft.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Access control and validation procedures
records.text: Implement procedures to control and validate a person's access to facilities based on their role or function, including visitor control, and control of access to software programs for testing and revision.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Maintenance records
records.text: Implement policies and procedures to document repairs and modifications to the physical components of a facility which are related to security (for example, hardware, walls, doors, and locks).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Workstation use
records.text: Implement policies and procedures that specify the proper functions to be performed, the manner in which those functions are to be performed, and the physical attributes of the surroundings of a specific workstation or class of workstation that can access electronic protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Workstation security
records.text: Implement physical safeguards for all workstations that access electronic protected health information, to restrict access to authorized users.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Device and media controls
records.text: Implement policies and procedures that govern the receipt and removal of hardware and electronic media that contain electronic protected health information into and out of a facility, and the movement of these items within the facility.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Disposal
records.text: Implement policies and procedures to address the final disposition of electronic protected health information, and/or the hardware or electronic media on which it is stored.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Media re-use
records.text: Implement procedures for removal of electronic protected health information from electronic media before the media are made available for re-use.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Accountability
records.text: Maintain a record of the movements of hardware and electronic media and any person responsible therefore.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Data backup and storage
records.text: Create a retrievable, exact copy of electronic protected health information, when needed, before movement of equipment.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Access control
records.text: Implement technical policies and procedures for electronic information systems that maintain electronic protected health information to allow access only to those persons or software programs that have been granted access rights as specified in § 164.308(a)(4).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Unique user identification
records.text: Assign a unique name and/or number for identifying and tracking user identity.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Emergency access procedure
records.text: Establish (and implement as needed) procedures for obtaining necessary electronic protected health information during an emergency.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Automatic logoff
records.text: Implement electronic procedures that terminate an electronic session after a predetermined time of inactivity.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Encryption and decryption
records.text: Implement a mechanism to encrypt and decrypt electronic protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Audit controls
records.text: Implement hardware, software, and/or procedural mechanisms that record and examine activity in information systems that contain or use electronic protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Integrity
records.text: Implement policies and procedures to protect electronic protected health information from improper alteration or destruction.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Mechanism to authenticate electronic protected health information
records.text: Implement electronic mechanisms to corroborate that electronic protected health information has not been altered or destroyed in an unauthorized manner.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Person or entity authentication
records.text: Implement procedures to verify that a person or entity seeking access to electronic protected health information is the one claimed.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Transmission security
records.text: Implement technical security measures to guard against unauthorized access to electronic protected health information that is being transmitted over an electronic communications network.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Integrity controls
records.text: Implement security measures to ensure that electronically transmitted electronic protected health information is not improperly modified without detection until disposed of.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Encryption
records.text: Implement a mechanism to encrypt electronic protected health information whenever deemed appropriate.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Business associate contracts or other arrangements
records.text: The contract or other arrangement required by § 164.308(b)(3) must meet the requirements of paragraph (a)(2)(i), (a)(2)(ii), or (a)(2)(iii) of this section, as applicable.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Implementation specifications
records.text: (i) Business associate contracts. The contract must provide that the business associate will—
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Requirements for group health plans
records.text: Except when the only electronic protected health information disclosed to a plan sponsor is disclosed pursuant to § 164.504(f)(1)(ii) or (iii), or as authorized under § 164.508, a group health plan must ensure that its plan documents provide that the plan sponsor will reasonably and appropriately safeguard electronic protected health information created, received, maintained, or transmitted to or by the plan sponsor on behalf of the group health plan.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Implementation specifications
records.text: The plan documents of the group health plan must be amended to incorporate provisions to require the plan sponsor to—
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Policies and procedures
records.text: Implement reasonable and appropriate policies and procedures to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, or other requirements of this subpart, taking into account those factors specified in § 164.306(b)(2)(i), (ii), (iii), and (iv). This standard is not to be construed to permit or excuse an action that violates any other standard, implementation specification, or other requirements of this subpart. A covered entity or business associate may change its policies and procedures at any time, provided that the changes are documented and are implemented in accordance with this subpart.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation
records.text: (i) Maintain the policies and procedures implemented to comply with this subpart in written (which may be electronic) form; and
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Time limit
records.text: Retain the documentation required by paragraph (b)(1) of this section for 6 years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Availability
records.text: Make documentation available to those persons responsible for implementing the procedures to which the documentation pertains.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Updates
records.text: Review documentation periodically, and update as needed, in response to environmental or operational changes affecting the security of the electronic protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart C (Security Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Notification to individuals
records.text: (a) Standard—(1) General rule. A covered entity shall, following the discovery of a breach of unsecured protected health information, notify each individual whose unsecured protected health information has been, or is reasonably believed by the covered entity to have been, accessed, acquired, used, or disclosed as a result of such breach.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01
notes: Section-level record. This subpart publishes no "Standard:" label, so the section is the assessable unit. The section is a published, citable unit of the CFR; no structure is invented.

records.title: Timeliness of notification
records.text: Except as provided in § 164.412, a covered entity shall provide the notification required by paragraph (a) of this section without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery of a breach.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Content of notification
records.text: —(1) Elements. The notification required by paragraph (a) of this section shall include, to the extent possible:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Methods of individual notification
records.text: The notification required by paragraph (a) of this section shall be provided in the following form:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Notification to the media
records.text: (a) Standard. For a breach of unsecured protected health information involving more than 500 residents of a State or jurisdiction, a covered entity shall, following the discovery of the breach as provided in § 164.404(a)(2), notify prominent media outlets serving the State or jurisdiction.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01
notes: Section-level record. This subpart publishes no "Standard:" label, so the section is the assessable unit. The section is a published, citable unit of the CFR; no structure is invented.

records.title: Timeliness of notification
records.text: Except as provided in § 164.412, a covered entity shall provide the notification required by paragraph (a) of this section without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery of a breach.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Content of notification
records.text: The notification required by paragraph (a) of this section shall meet the requirements of § 164.404(c).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Notification to the Secretary
records.text: (a) Standard. A covered entity shall, following the discovery of a breach of unsecured protected health information as provided in § 164.404(a)(2), notify the Secretary.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01
notes: Section-level record. This subpart publishes no "Standard:" label, so the section is the assessable unit. The section is a published, citable unit of the CFR; no structure is invented.

records.title: Breaches involving 500 or more individuals
records.text: For breaches of unsecured protected health information involving 500 or more individuals, a covered entity shall, except as provided in § 164.412, provide the notification required by paragraph (a) of this section contemporaneously with the notice required by § 164.404(a) and in the manner specified on the HHS Web site.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Breaches involving less than 500 individuals
records.text: For breaches of unsecured protected health information involving less than 500 individuals, a covered entity shall maintain a log or other documentation of such breaches and, not later than 60 days after the end of each calendar year, provide the notification required by paragraph (a) of this section for breaches discovered during the preceding calendar year, in the manner specified on the HHS web site.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Notification by a business associate
records.text: (a) Standard—(1) General rule. A business associate shall, following the discovery of a breach of unsecured protected health information, notify the covered entity of such breach.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01
notes: Section-level record. This subpart publishes no "Standard:" label, so the section is the assessable unit. The section is a published, citable unit of the CFR; no structure is invented.

records.title: Timeliness of notification
records.text: Except as provided in § 164.412, a business associate shall provide the notification required by paragraph (a) of this section without unreasonable delay and in no case later than 60 calendar days after discovery of a breach.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Content of notification
records.text: (1) The notification required by paragraph (a) of this section shall include, to the extent possible, the identification of each individual whose unsecured protected health information has been, or is reasonably believed by the business associate to have been, accessed, acquired, used, or disclosed during the breach.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Law enforcement delay
records.text: If a law enforcement official states to a covered entity or business associate that a notification, notice, or posting required under this subpart would impede a criminal investigation or cause damage to national security, a covered entity or business associate shall:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01
notes: Section-level record. This subpart publishes no "Standard:" label, so the section is the assessable unit. The section is a published, citable unit of the CFR; no structure is invented.

records.title: Administrative requirements and burden of proof
records.text: (a) Administrative requirements. A covered entity is required to comply with the administrative requirements of § 164.530(b), (d), (e), (g), (h), (i), and (j) with respect to the requirements of this subpart.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart D (Breach Notification Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01
notes: Section-level record. This subpart publishes no "Standard:" label, so the section is the assessable unit. The section is a published, citable unit of the CFR; no structure is invented.

records.title: Minimum necessary
records.text: — Minimum necessary applies. When using or disclosing protected health information or when requesting protected health information from another covered entity or business associate, a covered entity or business associate must make reasonable efforts to limit protected health information to the minimum necessary to accomplish the intended purpose of the use, disclosure, or request.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures of protected health information subject to an agreed upon restriction
records.text: A covered entity that has agreed to a restriction pursuant to § 164.522(a)(1) may not use or disclose the protected health information covered by the restriction in violation of such restriction, except as otherwise provided in § 164.522(a).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures of de-identified protected health information
records.text: —(1) Uses and disclosures to create de-identified information. A covered entity may use protected health information to create information that is not individually identifiable health information or disclose protected health information only to a business associate for such purpose, whether or not the de-identified information is to be used by the covered entity.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Disclosures to business associates
records.text: (i) A covered entity may disclose protected health information to a business associate and may allow a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit protected health information on its behalf, if the covered entity obtains satisfactory assurance that the business associate will appropriately safeguard the information. A covered entity is not required to obtain such satisfactory assurances from a business associate that is a subcontractor.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation
records.text: The satisfactory assurances required by paragraph (e)(1) of this section must be documented through a written contract or other written agreement or arrangement with the business associate that meets the applicable requirements of § 164.504(e).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Deceased individuals
records.text: A covered entity must comply with the requirements of this subpart with respect to the protected health information of a deceased individual for a period of 50 years following the death of the individual.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Personal representatives
records.text: As specified in this paragraph, a covered entity must, except as provided in paragraphs (g)(3) and (g)(5) of this section, treat a personal representative as the individual for purposes of this subchapter.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Adults and emancipated minors
records.text: If under applicable law a person has authority to act on behalf of an individual who is an adult or an emancipated minor in making decisions related to health care, a covered entity must treat such person as a personal representative under this subchapter, with respect to protected health information relevant to such personal representation.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Unemancipated minors
records.text: If under applicable law a parent, guardian, or other person acting in loco parentis has authority to act on behalf of an individual who is an unemancipated minor in making decisions related to health care, a covered entity must treat such person as a personal representative under this subchapter, with respect to protected health information relevant to such personal representation, except that such person may not be a personal representative of an unemancipated minor, and the minor has the authority to act as an individual, with respect to protected health information pertaining to a health care service, if:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Deceased individuals
records.text: If under applicable law an executor, administrator, or other person has authority to act on behalf of a deceased individual or of the individual's estate, a covered entity must treat such person as a personal representative under this subchapter, with respect to protected health information relevant to such personal representation.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Abuse, neglect, endangerment situations
records.text: Notwithstanding a State law or any requirement of this paragraph to the contrary, a covered entity may elect not to treat a person as the personal representative, provided that the conditions at paragraphs (g)(5)(i) and (ii) of this section are met:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Confidential communications
records.text: A covered health care provider or health plan must comply with the applicable requirements of § 164.522(b) in communicating protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures consistent with notice
records.text: A covered entity that is required by § 164.520 to have a notice may not use or disclose protected health information in a manner inconsistent with such notice. A covered entity that is required by § 164.520(b)(1)(iii) to include a specific statement in its notice if it intends to engage in an activity listed in § 164.520(b)(1)(iii)(A)-(C), may not use or disclose protected health information for such activities, unless the required statement is included in the notice.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Disclosures by whistleblowers and workforce member crime victims
records.text: —(1) Disclosures by whistleblowers. A covered entity is not considered to have violated the requirements of this subpart if a member of its workforce or a business associate discloses protected health information, provided that:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Business associate contracts
records.text: (i) The contract or other arrangement required by § 164.502(e)(2) must meet the requirements of paragraph (e)(2), (e)(3), or (e)(5) of this section, as applicable.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Business associate contracts
records.text: A contract between the covered entity and a business associate must:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Other arrangements
records.text: (i) If a covered entity and its business associate are both governmental entities:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Other requirements for contracts and other arrangements
records.text: (i) The contract or other arrangement between the covered entity and the business associate may permit the business associate to use the protected health information received by the business associate in its capacity as a business associate to the covered entity, if necessary:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Business associate contracts with subcontractors
records.text: The requirements of § 164.504(e)(2) through (e)(4) apply to the contract or other arrangement required by § 164.502(e)(1)(ii) between a business associate and a business associate that is a subcontractor in the same manner as such requirements apply to contracts or other arrangements between a covered entity and business associate.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Requirements for group health plans
records.text: (i) Except as provided under paragraph (f)(1)(ii) or (iii) of this section or as otherwise authorized under § 164.508, a group health plan, in order to disclose protected health information to the plan sponsor or to provide for or permit the disclosure of protected health information to the plan sponsor by a health insurance issuer or HMO with respect to the group health plan, must ensure that the plan documents restrict uses and disclosures of such information by the plan sponsor consistent with the requirements of this subpart.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Requirements for plan documents
records.text: The plan documents of the group health plan must be amended to incorporate provisions to:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures
records.text: A group health plan may:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Requirements for a covered entity with multiple covered functions
records.text: (1) A covered entity that performs multiple covered functions that would make the entity any combination of a health plan, a covered health care provider, and a health care clearinghouse, must comply with the standards, requirements, and implementation specifications of this subpart, as applicable to the health plan, health care provider, or health care clearinghouse covered functions performed.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Permitted uses and disclosures
records.text: Except with respect to uses or disclosures that require an authorization under § 164.508(a)(2) through (4) or that are prohibited under § 164.502(a)(5)(i), a covered entity may use or disclose protected health information for treatment, payment, or health care operations as set forth in paragraph (c) of this section, provided that such use or disclosure is consistent with other applicable requirements of this subpart.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Consent for uses and disclosures permitted
records.text: (1) A covered entity may obtain consent of the individual to use or disclose protected health information to carry out treatment, payment, or health care operations.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Treatment, payment, or health care operations
records.text: (1) A covered entity may use or disclose protected health information for its own treatment, payment, or health care operations.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Authorizations for uses and disclosures
records.text: —(1) Authorization required: General rule. Except as otherwise permitted or required by this subchapter, a covered entity may not use or disclose protected health information without an authorization that is valid under this section. When a covered entity obtains or receives a valid authorization for its use or disclosure of protected health information, such use or disclosure must be consistent with such authorization.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: General requirements
records.text: —(1) Valid authorizations. (i) A valid authorization is a document that meets the requirements in paragraphs (a)(3)(ii), (a)(4)(ii), (c)(1), and (c)(2) of this section, as applicable.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Core elements and requirements
records.text: —(1) Core elements. A valid authorization under this section must contain at least the following elements:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Attestations for certain uses and disclosures of protected health information to persons other than covered entities or business associates
records.text: (1) A covered entity or business associate may not use or disclose protected health information potentially related to reproductive health care for purposes specified in § 164.512(d), (e), (f), or (g)(1), without obtaining an attestation that is valid under paragraph (b)(1) of this section from the person requesting the use or disclosure and complying with all applicable conditions of this part.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: General requirements
records.text: —(1) Valid attestations. (i) A valid attestation is a document that meets the requirements of paragraph (c)(1) of this section.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Content requirements and other obligations
records.text: —(1) Required elements. A valid attestation under this section must contain the following elements:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Use and disclosure for facility directories
records.text: —(1) Permitted uses and disclosure. Except when an objection is expressed in accordance with paragraphs (a)(2) or (3) of this section, a covered health care provider may:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures for involvement in the individual's care and notification purposes
records.text: —(1) Permitted uses and disclosures. (i) A covered entity may, in accordance with paragraphs (b)(2), (b)(3), or (b)(5) of this section, disclose to a family member, other relative, or a close personal friend of the individual, or any other person identified by the individual, the protected health information directly relevant to such person's involvement with the individual's health care or payment related to the individual's health care.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures required by law
records.text: (1) A covered entity may use or disclose protected health information to the extent that such use or disclosure is required by law and the use or disclosure complies with and is limited to the relevant requirements of such law.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures for public health activities
records.text: —(1) Permitted uses and disclosures. A covered entity may use or disclose protected health information for the public health activities and purposes described in this paragraph to:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Disclosures about victims of abuse, neglect, or domestic violence
records.text: —(1) Permitted disclosures. Except for reports of child abuse or neglect permitted by paragraph (b)(1)(ii) of this section, a covered entity may disclose protected health information about an individual whom the covered entity reasonably believes to be a victim of abuse, neglect, or domestic violence to a government authority, including a social service or protective services agency, authorized by law to receive reports of such abuse, neglect, or domestic violence:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures for health oversight activities
records.text: —(1) Permitted disclosures. A covered entity may disclose protected health information to a health oversight agency for oversight activities authorized by law, including audits; civil, administrative, or criminal investigations; inspections; licensure or disciplinary actions; civil, administrative, or criminal proceedings or actions; or other activities necessary for appropriate oversight of:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Disclosures for judicial and administrative proceedings
records.text: —(1) Permitted disclosures. A covered entity may disclose protected health information in the course of any judicial or administrative proceeding:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Disclosures for law enforcement purposes
records.text: A covered entity may disclose protected health information for a law enforcement purpose to a law enforcement official if the conditions in paragraphs (f)(1) through (f)(6) of this section are met, as applicable.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures about decedents
records.text: —(1) Coroners and medical examiners. A covered entity may disclose protected health information to a coroner or medical examiner for the purpose of identifying a deceased person, determining a cause of death, or other duties as authorized by law. A covered entity that also performs the duties of a coroner or medical examiner may use protected health information for the purposes described in this paragraph.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures for cadaveric organ, eye or tissue donation purposes
records.text: A covered entity may use or disclose protected health information to organ procurement organizations or other entities engaged in the procurement, banking, or transplantation of cadaveric organs, eyes, or tissue for the purpose of facilitating organ, eye or tissue donation and transplantation.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures for research purposes
records.text: —(1) Permitted uses and disclosures. A covered entity may use or disclose protected health information for research, regardless of the source of funding of the research, provided that:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures to avert a serious threat to health or safety
records.text: —(1) Permitted disclosures. A covered entity may, consistent with applicable law and standards of ethical conduct, use or disclose protected health information, if the covered entity, in good faith, believes the use or disclosure:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures for specialized government functions
records.text: —(1) Military and veterans activities—(i) Armed Forces personnel. A covered entity may use and disclose the protected health information of individuals who are Armed Forces personnel for activities deemed necessary by appropriate military command authorities to assure the proper execution of the military mission, if the appropriate military authority has published by notice in the Federal Register the following information:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Disclosures for workers' compensation
records.text: A covered entity may disclose protected health information as authorized by and to the extent necessary to comply with laws relating to workers' compensation or other similar programs, established by law, that provide benefits for work-related injuries or illness without regard to fault.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: De-identification of protected health information
records.text: Health information that does not identify an individual and with respect to which there is no reasonable basis to believe that the information can be used to identify an individual is not individually identifiable health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Requirements for de-identification of protected health information
records.text: A covered entity may determine that health information is not individually identifiable health information only if:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Re-identification
records.text: A covered entity may assign a code or other means of record identification to allow information de-identified under this section to be re-identified by the covered entity, provided that:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: minimum necessary requirements
records.text: In order to comply with § 164.502(b) and this section, a covered entity must meet the requirements of paragraphs (d)(2) through (d)(5) of this section with respect to a request for, or the use and disclosure of, protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Minimum necessary uses of protected health information
records.text: (i) A covered entity must identify:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Minimum necessary disclosures of protected health information
records.text: (i) For any type of disclosure that it makes on a routine and recurring basis, a covered entity must implement policies and procedures (which may be standard protocols) that limit the protected health information disclosed to the amount reasonably necessary to achieve the purpose of the disclosure.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Minimum necessary requests for protected health information
records.text: (i) A covered entity must limit any request for protected health information to that which is reasonably necessary to accomplish the purpose for which the request is made, when requesting such information from other covered entities.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Other content requirement
records.text: For all uses, disclosures, or requests to which the requirements in paragraph (d) of this section apply, a covered entity may not use, disclose or request an entire medical record, except when the entire medical record is specifically justified as the amount that is reasonably necessary to accomplish the purpose of the use, disclosure, or request.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Limited data set
records.text: A covered entity may use or disclose a limited data set that meets the requirements of paragraphs (e)(2) and (e)(3) of this section, if the covered entity enters into a data use agreement with the limited data set recipient, in accordance with paragraph (e)(4) of this section.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Limited data set:
records.text: A limited data set is protected health information that excludes the following direct identifiers of the individual or of relatives, employers, or household members of the individual:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Permitted purposes for uses and disclosures
records.text: (i) A covered entity may use or disclose a limited data set under paragraph (e)(1) of this section only for the purposes of research, public health, or health care operations.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Data use agreement
records.text: —(i) Agreement required. A covered entity may use or disclose a limited data set under paragraph (e)(1) of this section only if the covered entity obtains satisfactory assurance, in the form of a data use agreement that meets the requirements of this section, that the limited data set recipient will only use or disclose the protected health information for limited purposes.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Fundraising requirements
records.text: (i) A covered entity may not use or disclose protected health information for fundraising purposes as otherwise permitted by paragraph (f)(1) of this section unless a statement required by § 164.520(b)(1)(iii)(A) is included in the covered entity's notice of privacy practices.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Uses and disclosures for underwriting and related purposes
records.text: If a health plan receives protected health information for the purpose of underwriting, premium rating, or other activities relating to the creation, renewal, or replacement of a contract of health insurance or health benefits, and if such health insurance or health benefits are not placed with the health plan, such health plan may only use or disclose such protected health information for such purpose or as may be required by law, subject to the prohibition at § 164.502(a)(5)(i) with respect to genetic information included in the protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Verification requirements
records.text: Prior to any disclosure permitted by this subpart, a covered entity must:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Verification
records.text: —(i) Conditions on disclosures. If a disclosure is conditioned by this subpart on particular documentation, statements, or representations from the person requesting the protected health information, a covered entity may rely, if such reliance is reasonable under the circumstances, on documentation, statements, or representations that, on their face, meet the applicable requirements.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Notice of privacy practices
records.text: —(1) Right to notice. Except as provided by paragraph (a)(3) or (4) of this section, an individual has a right to adequate notice of the uses and disclosures of protected health information that may be made by the covered entity, and of the individual's rights and the covered entity's legal duties with respect to protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Content of notice
records.text: —(1) Required elements. The covered entity, including any covered entity receiving or maintaining records subject to 42 U.S.C. 290dd-2, must provide a notice that is written in plain language and that contains the elements required by this paragraph.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Provision of notice
records.text: A covered entity must make the notice required by this section available on request to any person and to individuals as specified in paragraphs (c)(1) through (c)(3) of this section, as applicable.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Joint notice by separate covered entities
records.text: Covered entities that participate in organized health care arrangements may comply with this section by a joint notice, provided that:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation
records.text: A covered entity must document compliance with the notice requirements, as required by § 164.530(j), by retaining copies of the notices issued by the covered entity and, if applicable, any written acknowledgments of receipt of the notice or documentation of good faith efforts to obtain such written acknowledgment, in accordance with paragraph (c)(2)(ii) of this section.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Right of an individual to request restriction of uses and disclosures
records.text: (i) A covered entity must permit an individual to request that the covered entity restrict:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Terminating a restriction
records.text: A covered entity may terminate a restriction, if:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation
records.text: A covered entity must document a restriction in accordance with § 160.530(j) of this subchapter.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Confidential communications requirements
records.text: (i) A covered health care provider must permit individuals to request and must accommodate reasonable requests by individuals to receive communications of protected health information from the covered health care provider by alternative means or at alternative locations.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Conditions on providing confidential communications
records.text: (i) A covered entity may require the individual to make a request for a confidential communication described in paragraph (b)(1) of this section in writing.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Access to protected health information
records.text: —(1) Right of access. Except as otherwise provided in paragraph (a)(2) or (a)(3) of this section, an individual has a right of access to inspect and obtain a copy of protected health information about the individual in a designated record set, for as long as the protected health information is maintained in the designated record set, except for:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Requests for access and timely action
records.text: —(1) Individual's request for access. The covered entity must permit an individual to request access to inspect or to obtain a copy of the protected health information about the individual that is maintained in a designated record set. The covered entity may require individuals to make requests for access in writing, provided that it informs individuals of such a requirement.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Provision of access
records.text: If the covered entity provides an individual with access, in whole or in part, to protected health information, the covered entity must comply with the following requirements.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Denial of access
records.text: If the covered entity denies access, in whole or in part, to protected health information, the covered entity must comply with the following requirements.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation
records.text: A covered entity must document the following and retain the documentation as required by § 164.530(j):
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Right to amend
records.text: (1) Right to amend. An individual has the right to have a covered entity amend protected health information or a record about the individual in a designated record set for as long as the protected health information is maintained in the designated record set.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Requests for amendment and timely action
records.text: —(1) Individual's request for amendment. The covered entity must permit an individual to request that the covered entity amend the protected health information maintained in the designated record set. The covered entity may require individuals to make requests for amendment in writing and to provide a reason to support a requested amendment, provided that it informs individuals in advance of such requirements.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Accepting the amendment
records.text: If the covered entity accepts the requested amendment, in whole or in part, the covered entity must comply with the following requirements.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Denying the amendment
records.text: If the covered entity denies the requested amendment, in whole or in part, the covered entity must comply with the following requirements.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Actions on notices of amendment
records.text: A covered entity that is informed by another covered entity of an amendment to an individual's protected health information, in accordance with paragraph (c)(3) of this section, must amend the protected health information in designated record sets as provided by paragraph (c)(1) of this section.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation
records.text: A covered entity must document the titles of the persons or offices responsible for receiving and processing requests for amendments by individuals and retain the documentation as required by § 164.530(j).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Right to an accounting of disclosures of protected health information
records.text: (1) An individual has a right to receive an accounting of disclosures of protected health information made by a covered entity in the six years prior to the date on which the accounting is requested, except for disclosures:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Content of the accounting
records.text: The covered entity must provide the individual with a written accounting that meets the following requirements.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Provision of the accounting
records.text: (1) The covered entity must act on the individual's request for an accounting, no later than 60 days after receipt of such a request, as follows.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation
records.text: A covered entity must document the following and retain the documentation as required by § 164.530(j):
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Personnel designations
records.text: (i) A covered entity must designate a privacy official who is responsible for the development and implementation of the policies and procedures of the entity.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Personnel designations
records.text: A covered entity must document the personnel designations in paragraph (a)(1) of this section as required by paragraph (j) of this section.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Training
records.text: A covered entity must train all members of its workforce on the policies and procedures with respect to protected health information required by this subpart and subpart D of this part, as necessary and appropriate for the members of the workforce to carry out their functions within the covered entity.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Training
records.text: (i) A covered entity must provide training that meets the requirements of paragraph (b)(1) of this section, as follows:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Safeguards
records.text: A covered entity must have in place appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect the privacy of protected health information.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Safeguards
records.text: A covered entity must reasonably safeguard protected health information from any intentional or unintentional use or disclosure that is in violation of the standards, implementation specifications or other requirements of this subpart.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Complaints to the covered entity
records.text: A covered entity must provide a process for individuals to make complaints concerning the covered entity's policies and procedures required by this subpart and subpart D of this part or its compliance with such policies and procedures or the requirements of this subpart or subpart D of this part.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation of complaints
records.text: As required by paragraph (j) of this section, a covered entity must document all complaints received, and their disposition, if any.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Sanctions
records.text: A covered entity must have and apply appropriate sanctions against members of its workforce who fail to comply with the privacy policies and procedures of the covered entity or the requirements of this subpart or subpart D of this part. This standard does not apply to a member of the covered entity's workforce with respect to actions that are covered by and that meet the conditions of § 164.502(j) or paragraph (g)(2) of this section.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Documentation
records.text: As required by paragraph (j) of this section, a covered entity must document the sanctions that are applied, if any.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Mitigation
records.text: A covered entity must mitigate, to the extent practicable, any harmful effect that is known to the covered entity of a use or disclosure of protected health information in violation of its policies and procedures or the requirements of this subpart by the covered entity or its business associate.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Refraining from intimidating or retaliatory acts
records.text: A covered entity—
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Waiver of rights
records.text: A covered entity may not require individuals to waive their rights under § 160.306 of this subchapter, this subpart, or subpart D of this part, as a condition of the provision of treatment, payment, enrollment in a health plan, or eligibility for benefits.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Policies and procedures
records.text: A covered entity must implement policies and procedures with respect to protected health information that are designed to comply with the standards, implementation specifications, or other requirements of this subpart and subpart D of this part. The policies and procedures must be reasonably designed, taking into account the size and the type of activities that relate to protected health information undertaken by a covered entity, to ensure such compliance. This standard is not to be construed to permit or excuse an action that violates any other standard, implementation specification, or other requirement of this subpart.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Changes to policies and procedures
records.text: (i) A covered entity must change its policies and procedures as necessary and appropriate to comply with changes in the law, including the standards, requirements, and implementation specifications of this subpart or subpart D of this part.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Changes in law
records.text: Whenever there is a change in law that necessitates a change to the covered entity's policies or procedures, the covered entity must promptly document and implement the revised policy or procedure. If the change in law materially affects the content of the notice required by § 164.520, the covered entity must promptly make the appropriate revisions to the notice in accordance with § 164.520(b)(3). Nothing in this paragraph may be used by a covered entity to excuse a failure to comply with the law.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Changes to privacy practices stated in the notice
records.text: (i) To implement a change as provided by paragraph (i)(2)(ii) of this section, a covered entity must:

records.title: Changes to other policies or procedures
records.text: A covered entity may change, at any time, a policy or procedure that does not materially affect the content of the notice required by § 164.520, provided that:

records.title: Retention period
records.text: A covered entity must retain the documentation required by paragraph (j)(1) of this section for six years from the date of its creation or the date when it last was in effect, whichever is later.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Group health plans
records.text: (1) A group health plan is not subject to the standards or implementation specifications in paragraphs (a) through (f) and (i) of this section, to the extent that:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Effect of prior authorizations
records.text: Notwithstanding §§ 164.508 and 164.512(i), a covered entity may use or disclose protected health information, consistent with paragraphs (b) and (c) of this section, pursuant to an authorization or other express legal permission obtained from an individual permitting the use or disclosure of protected health information, informed consent of the individual to participate in research, a waiver of informed consent by an IRB, or a waiver of authorization in accordance with § 164.512(i)(1)(i).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Effect of prior authorization for purposes other than research
records.text: Notwithstanding any provisions in § 164.508, a covered entity may use or disclose protected health information that it created or received prior to the applicable compliance date of this subpart pursuant to an authorization or other express legal permission obtained from an individual prior to the applicable compliance date of this subpart, provided that the authorization or other express legal permission specifically permits such use or disclosure and there is no agreed-to restriction in accordance with § 164.522(a).
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Effect of prior permission for research
records.text: Notwithstanding any provisions in §§ 164.508 and 164.512(i), a covered entity may, to the extent allowed by one of the following permissions, use or disclose, for research, protected health information that it created or received either before or after the applicable compliance date of this subpart, provided that there is no agreed-to restriction in accordance with § 164.522(a), and the covered entity has obtained, prior to the applicable compliance date, either:
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Effect of prior contracts or other arrangements with business associates
records.text: Notwithstanding any other provisions of this part, a covered entity, or business associate with respect to a subcontractor, may disclose protected health information to a business associate and may allow a business associate to create, receive, maintain, or transmit protected health information on its behalf pursuant to a written contract or other written arrangement with such business associate that does not comply with §§ 164.308(b), 164.314(a), 164.502(e), and 164.504(e), only in accordance with paragraph (e) of this section.
records.source: eCFR Title 45 Part 164 Subpart E (Privacy Rule), snapshot 2026-07-01

records.title: Deemed compliance
records.text: —(1) Qualification. Notwithstanding other sections of this part, a covered entity, or business associate with respect to a subcontractor, is deemed to be in compliance with the documentation and contract requirements of §§ 164.308(b), 164.314(a), 164.502(e), and 164.504(e), with respect to a particular business associate relationship, for the time period set forth in paragraph (e)(2) of this section, if:
